text: The Masters' Cavern is a large cavern in Hallvalor in . It houses the proving grounds where warriors of the train to become blademasters.
Mastering the Menagerie replaces Battle Pet Roundup / Scrappin' when the Menagerie building is upgraded to Level 3.
Master Vel'domis is a draenei located at Sha'tari Market District in Talador. He is found meditating, surrounded by numerous frozen Iron Horde troops.
Master Treasure Hunter is an exploration achievement earned from discovering 100 treasures of (excluding Tanaan Jungle).
Master Smith Helgar is a Valarjar iron vrykul located in the Skyhold. The mightiest weapons of the valarjar are crafted by him. He later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Master of the Seas is an account-wide achievement earned from completing five naval mission achievements.
Master and Commander is an achievement earned by defeating all of the summonable garrison raid bosses.
Master of Shadows is a Subtlety rogue talent. It is an exclusive choice node with The First Dance.
Mastery: Fel Blood is the mastery effect for Vengeance demon hunters. It becomes available at level 10 and is improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Nature's Guardian is the mastery for Guardian druids, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It is learned at level 10.
Mastery: Starlight was the Mastery for Balance druids, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Hunting Companion is the Mastery for Survival hunters, improved by the Mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Savant is the Mastery for Arcane mages, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It is learned at level 10.
Mastery: Gust of Mists is the Mastery for Mistweaver monks, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Combo Strikes is the Mastery for Windwalker monks, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Divine Judgment is the Mastery for Retribution paladins, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Lightbringer is the Mastery for Holy paladins, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Absolution is the Mastery for Discipline priests, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Chaotic Energies is the Mastery for Destruction warlocks, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Colossal Might is the Mastery for Arms warriors, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Demonic Presence is the mastery effect for Havoc demon hunters. It becomes available at level 10 and is improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Masterwork Silkweave Bracers is crafted by tailors. The recipe is only available during the quest.
Master Paku is a pandaren located at the Bizmo's Brawlpub. He is a juror during :The Brawlpub Trial and :The Brawl'gar Trial.
Masterwork Leystone Armguards are crafted with Blacksmithing. The recipe is only available during the quest.

Master Xunsu is a mistweaver of the Terrace of Endless Spring. They have spoken at length about Sheilun, Staff of the Mists and are quoted twice in The Chronicle of Ages. Xunsu is also the author of How to Meditate in a Hurricane, which contains instructions on the art of surrounding oneself with peace even amidst great external turmoil.

Master of the Isles is the fourth and final quest meant to be a guide to direct you back to the Command Map in your Order Hall to start the questline of another zone, much like how you were asked to choose a zone to start in after getting your first artifact. However, since players would have already gotten all the Pillars by this time from following their Order Hall quests and the previous breadcrumb quests, this one is merely a back up for those that didn't, and is not completable by the majority of the player base.
Master of Combinations is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Split Personality (artifact trait) and Thunderfist (artifact trait) traits.
Master Swoo is a pandaren located in The Wandering Isle. In the order hall he recruits Masters of Serenity.
Mata Whitebull is a tauren located in the Laughing Crane on the Wandering Isle. Every morning he runs around the Wandering Isle twice.
Masterful Felblades are wrathguard located in Invasion Points.
__NOTOC__ Mathrin Wildclaw is one of the that can be freed from his Feral Worgen form with the Scythe of Elune (artifact).
Matan is a Zandalari troll located at Hall of Beasts in Dazar'alor.
Matron Levae is a matron located at the Elderstone Mine in Drustvar.
Matron Elsbeth Garrick is a matron located in the Crimson Forest in Drustvar.
Matron Ceridwen is a matron located in Drustvar. She comes from Upper Corlain.
Mastery: Deep Wounds is the Mastery for Arms warriors, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Master Photobomber can be summoned when Photo B.O.M.B. is used. The NPC may appear as Fleet Master Seahorn, Chromie, Image of Archmage Vargoth, or Cro Threadstrong.
Master of Beasts is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Jaws of Thunder traits
Master of the Elements is an Elemental shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Electric Discharge and Shamanistic Healing traits.

Masterful Shadowrubies are created with Jewelcrafting (40); taught by Design: Masterful Shadowruby.
Master Pyong-Xu is a pandaren located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Mastery: Spirit Bond is the mastery effect for Survival hunters. It is improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Masterful Queen's Opal is created with Jewelcrafting (1); taught by Design: Masterful Queen's Opal.
Matriarch Jawbreaker is a deceased crocolisk located in Nazmir.
Matron Leasan is a harpy encountered by Class Order champions in Tel'anor in Suramar.
Master of Seething Shore is a player vs. player achievement earned by completing various Seething Shore achievements.
Master of Duels is a player vs. player achievement earned by completing a series of Dueler's Guild achievements.
Master of Minions is a pet battle achievement earned by collecting 1000 unique pets.
Masterful Instincts is an Azerite trait available to Feral and Guardian druids.
Mat da Wheeler & Dealer is a Zandalari troll whose skull can be found at the Head Shop in Dazar'alor.
__NOTOC__ Matriarch Ta'dolla is a broker. She leads Cartel Ta. She will occasionally portal in to the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos.

__NOTOC__ Master Shadeweavers are Maw casters located at the Altar of Domination in the Maw.

Masterful Laestrite Chokers are created with Jewelcrafting (25); taught by Appraiser Au'vesk in Oribos.
__NOTOC__ Master Runeshapers are liches located in the Spire of War and Unyielding Assembly in Maldraxxus.
Master Navigator is an expansion feature achievement earned by unlocking Rank III of your Sanctum's Travel Network.
Master of the Path is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating all ten Trials of Humility without any charms or active braziers.
Master of Ceremonies is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing 10 Events during a single Ember Court.
Master of Time is a mage class talent, improving Alter Time by reducing its cooldown by 30 seconds and resetting the cooldown of Blink when the effect completes itself.
The Matrix Beacon is provided as an objective for Lost Records.

It seems Master Snowdrift might be driving his students a bit hard.

Mastering the Waygates is a quest achievement earned by unlocking all of the Ancient Waygate locations within the Dragon Isles by completing: *Waygate: Rusza'thar Reach *Waygate: Skytop Observatory *Waygate: Vakthros *Waygate: Algeth'era *Waygate: Eon's Fringe *Waygate: Shady Sanctuary
Masud the Wise is a human located at Forkriver Crossing in the Ohn'ahran Plains and the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span. He has a pet named Mosey and is found speaking with Pakina.
Mastery: Life-Binder is the Mastery for Preservation evokers, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Astral Invocation is the mastery of Balance druids and is learned at level 10. It is increased by the mastery secondary stat.
Matriarch's Opulent Girdle drops from Broodkeeper Diurna in the Vault of the Incarnates.
__NOTOC__ Mastodon Tusk is a crafting reagent from the Dragon Isles.
__NOTOC__ Masterwork Smock is a profession accessory for leatherworking made with Dragon Isles Leatherworking; taught by Pattern: Masterwork Smock.
Mastery: Timewalker is the Mastery for Augmentation evokers, improved by the mastery secondary stat.
Matilda's Favorite Fishing Rod likely belongs to Fisher Matilda.
Matriarch Bluepelt is a gnoll located in the Azure Span. She has captured Prince Llane Wrynn.

Master of the Turbulent Timeways is a timewalking achievement that is earned by earning a total of four stacks of the Knowledge of Timeways for each week of the Turbulent Timeways. The buff lasts for 2 hours and will reset after every timewalking dungeon cleared. After obtaining four stacks of the buff, it'll change to the Mastery of Timeways buff, afterwards the buff can't be obtained again until the next Timewalking expansion during the event.

Mastery of Timeways can be obtained by earning four stacks of the Knowledge of Timeways buff during the Turbulent Timeways event. This buff can only be earned once each week and obtaining five of these buffs five separate times is required for the achievement Master of the Turbulent Timeways.
Maul is a Guardian druid Bear form attack. It is a rage dump, an attack designed to be used "when you have more Rage than you can spend."
Maurin Bonesplitter is a Forsaken quest giver located in Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
Maur Grimtotem was a tauren who died within Ragefire Chasm. His corpse was likely taken from the cavern and buried, but previously it was guarded by Oggleflint.

Maws is a massive shark boss that guards the Blue Scepter Shard of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands. Azuregos refers to Maws as a "minnow". He is summoned by using an Arcanite Buoy at the Swirling Maelstrom, which is an enormous patch of floating wreckage off the coast of Azshara.

Maur Raincaller is a tauren quest giver located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by the Alliance when they marched to capture the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens.
Mavralyn was a leather armor and leatherworking vendor located in Auberdine in Darkshore. When the Cataclysm struck, she tried to flee from Auberdine's destruction but died on the nearby beach.
Maul of the Redeemed Crusader is a two-handed mace with caster stats. It usually falls best in the hands of a paladin or shaman, considering druids find better damage staves.
Mature Black Dragon Sinew was a drop from Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair that was required by the hunter epic quest chain.

__NOTOC__ Mavoris Cloudsbreak is a night elf ghost found in the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale. Kayneth Stillwind and Gaivan Shadewalker would like Mavoris to be put to rest because he turned insane by the taint of the Forest Heart.

__NOTOC__ Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins is a ghoul found on the Crystal Shore of the Cape of Stranglethorn. He liked to gamble and often gambled with the ogres of Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound, but was chased away after winning too much. He also owes a debt to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley, even in undeath, and "Sea Wolf" wants his money.
The Mature Spore Sacs can be found throughout the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh. They hold the young Sporelings, soon to 'hatch'.
Maury's Key drops from the following Mosh'Ogg ogres in Stranglethorn Vale: * Mosh'Ogg Shaman * Mosh'Ogg Warmonger * Mosh'Ogg Spellcrafter * Mosh'Ogg Mauler * Mosh'Ogg Lord * Mosh'Ogg Butcher

Matt Uelmen is a composer who wrote some of the themes and music for World of Warcraft and World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. In his childhood, Uelman played classical piano, before moving on to other instruments and genres. In 1993, he sent demos of his work "to every developer who was working on 16-bit games in the San Francisco Bay Area." He created the music using the technical specs of the Sega Genesis.
The Mausoleum Trigger can be found next to the mausoleum in Brill's graveyard in Tirisfal Glades.
Maw of Neltharion is a cavern that leads into a volcano located at the western end of Obsidian Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight. Its name is derived from Neltharion the Earth-Warder.
Mature Stag Horns drop from Silvercoat Stags in Grizzly Hills.
Matthias Lehner is a ghostly child, who appears in several locations in Icecrown, offering several quests related to the Lich King depending on his location.
Matthew Ackerman is the stable master for the Amberpine Lodge, which is located in the Southwestern portion of the Grizzly Hills. He is a member of the Valiance Expedition.
Mature Water-Poppy are found in the Drak'Sotra Fields in Zul'Drak.
Mature Lashers are orchids found in Steppe of Life in Wintergrasp.

The Mature Language Filter prevents rude words from being seen in chat. Whenever a person swears, anyone with the filter enabled will see something like #@$^. Many players choose to turn the filter off.
The Maw of Madness is a subzone of the Twilight Highlands where Iso'rath dwells. The surrounding landscape is defiled and filled with Iso'rath's tentacles, in addition to numerous faceless ones.
These weapons have wickedly serrated blades that occasionally drip blood when worn.

The Maw of the Void is a subzone of Darkshore southeast of Lor'danel. It is a massive whirlpool that all of the water of the zone, like the Cliffspring River, drains into. Jumping into it treats the player to a short cutscene of their character being sucked into the whirlpool. Players end up in the Bashal'Aran Collapse, falling a far distance, but lands safely. It is possible to obtain Going Down? without a chance of death from the fall. During Brewfest you can get completely smashed and jump into the whirlpool to get Almost Blind Luck. During the Battle for Darkshore, the area was taken by the Twilight's Hammer.
__NOTOC__ The Maul of Stone Guard Mur'og is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Orc Archaeology Fragments to complete and allows the use of two Keystones.

The Maw of Shu'ma is the monstrous maw of Shu'ma found in the Dragon Soul and is host to acidic spawns. Yor'sahj the Unsleeping is found within, commanding the faceless ones in their assault against Wyrmrest Temple and binds the blood of the ancient horror to his will.

Maw of Oblivion is a 2-piece dagger set obtained by rogues from the quest Victory in the Depths, part of the quest chain to get .
The Maw of Destruction has burst through the Path of the Titans and has assaulted the Wyrmrest Temple within the Hour of Twilight
Matt "Lucky" Gotcher is a human found at Nesingwary's Safari in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Maws of Despair are sha located in the Temple of the Red Crane in the Krasarang Wilds.
Mature Flame Hounds are hell hounds that can be found in Ragefire Chasm.
Matty is a Battle Pet Trainer located in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar. He is accompanied by his level 5 battle pet crab, Snappy. He provides training for Battle Pets for .
__NOTOC__ Matthew Churchill is a human stable master located at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.
Maturing Raptor are level 90 raptors found at the Beast Pens on Isle of Thunder.

Mawre Sternhorn was the mate of Kirge Sternhorn. She was killed during the massacre of Camp Taurajo, but Kirge and their unnamed son made it out alive. Kirge has sworn to avenge Mawre's death, even if it means his son will grow up without either of his parents.
Mawago is a tauren found in Zul'Aman. He has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.

Mature Swines are boars used as food by the orcs of Durotar. They are found in several farms in Durotar, the largest number of them being in Jaggedswine Farm. When speaking with Garrosh Hellscream, Varok Saurfang claimed that the sound of pigs being killed for food reminds him and other orc veterans of the sound the innocent draenei children they killed when under the effects of the Blood of Mannoroth.

Matt Golins is senior user interface designer for World of Warcraft.

Matthew Versluys led the engineering team for Battle.net at Blizzard Entertainment for 16 years, connecting players on every Blizzard game from Diablo II to Overwatch. He is now part of Bonfire Studios along with other former Blizzard employees.

Mawrats are creatures found in Shadowlands, roaming the Maw and the corridors of Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Though their size might not pose a threat, their nails are capable of inflicting fatal diseases to an idle fighter.
Mawsworn Archers are located in Skoldus Hall in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mawsworn Disciples are Maw casters located in the Fracture Chambers in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Mature Bone Crawlers are bone worms located in the center of the Broken Shore. Juvenile bone crawlers and even grub versions of the worms can be found here as well. The Mawsworn are minions who serve Zovaal the Jailer in the Maw. They bring pain and punishment to the most wicked of souls. These soldiers are the very worst the damned have to offer: the result of the Jailer torturing mortal souls until only a mere shade of their former glory remains and they willingly serve their tormentor for eternity, all begin as empty suits of armor forged at Zovaal's Cauldron, and then are infused with a decrepit shade to be brought to "life". The size of the Mawsworn army rivals that of the Burning Legion, and with the soul-river Gorgoa overflowing, their ranks continue to swell. The Mawsworn's weapons and armor were designed by the Runecarver against his will.
Mawsworn Adjutants are Mawsworn located in Gorgoa: River of Souls in the Maw. They will try to trap any Helpless Soul that gets too close.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Myrmidon are Mawsworn kyrian located in Cocyrus in the Maw. They are also seen swarming the airspace just before Korthia during Mysteries of the Maw.
Mawsworn Allseers are soul seekers located in the Hungering Wastes in the Maw.

Mawsteel Cages are cages located in the Tremaculum in the Maw. The cages are opened with a Mawsworn Key, and each contain two or three Shackled Souls.
Mawforged Locks are located in the Tremaculum in the Maw. The locks keep Anduin Wrynn in chains. They can be opened with the Afflictor's Key.

, a maw guard.]] Maw guards (or Mawguards) are humanoid Mawsworn. These Mawsworn begin as inanimate suits of armor, forged by the stygian smiths of Zovaal's Cauldron. Once fashioned, they await infusion of a decrepit shade to complete their genesis.

Mawsworn Caches are chests found in the Mawsworn-held areas of Korthia, and also in Perdition Hold of the Maw during the Necrolord Assault. Both zones' units respawn daily. The Korthian units contain roughly 4-5x Relic Fragment, 5-7x uncommon-quality anima items (25-35 anima), 50 Stygia, and rarely a Sleeping Armament. In the Maw, they contain 30 Stygia, and one of the chests will contain a Quartered Ancient Ring, one of four for Nilganihmaht's Stone Ring to create Nilganihmaht Control Ring. If players are in the Overcharged Centurion after completing Putting A Plan Together, the caches can also contain the Defense Map, which starts a bonus quest: Clearing the Walls.
